_doc.file: Write the real list to the path Agents Map is started with (--attention); replace it atomically: write a temp file, then rename. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_doc.updated: Required. ISO date-time of this write; no zone means local time, Z accepted. Older than 6 h shows as stale.
_doc.owner: Required. The writer's RepoPrompt session id; its box carries items without a shown agent.
_doc.items: Up to 50. A bad item is dropped with a warning; a bad header drops the whole list.
_doc.items[].id: Required. Unique slug: letters, digits, . _ -; at most 64 characters.
_doc.items[].reason: Required. 1 to 80 characters; longer drops the item.
_doc.items[].due: Optional. ISO date (all-day) or date-time; no zone means local time. Remove calendar items once they have started.
_doc.items[].agent: Optional. RepoPrompt session id of the agent it concerns, or null.
_doc.items[].alert: Optional. none (default: still badge) | glow (slow breath) | pulse (stronger, faster). Glow and pulse count as 'need you' and Seen calms them.
_doc.alert levels: The writer chooses how loudly each item asks; kind, due and rank are information only.
